author: Kevin B. Liu
description: The owner's loading-screen gallery, all of it, in its order (its close-ups, then its elevated stills): each a scene staged in the Scene Studio and rendered at 4K by the game engine, at 1920 and its smaller rungs; the battle galleries and the manual's archive show them (src/ui/galleryShots.ts GALLERY_SHOTS). Each still's focal aims a crop at its hero tank.
sources: the 4K stills of the Scene Studio renders under shots/media-r5/site50/elevated-269 (each item's source names its file, its revision the commit it was rendered on)
